lines: when you're watching a movie
and your parents walk in at the sex scene

BUT YOU GUYS DIDN'T LIKE IT

SARAH IS ONLINE. SARAH IS OFFLINE. YOU: HEY
HAVE YOU EVER WOKE UP, KISSED THE PERSON BESIDE YOU AND JUST BEEN THANKFUL YOU'RE ALIVE

THEN SHE GOT EVERYONE'S ATTENTION AND SAID, " ALL OF YOU ARE ALIVE BECAUSE I GOT LAID"

WHEN I FINISHED SOMEONE IN THE NEXT STALL CLAPPED
I ONCE DATED A WOMAN NAMED DEBORAH WHO HATED WHEN I CALLED HER DEB
THEN I DATED A WOMAN NAMED SUSAN WHO REALLY HATED WHEN I CALLED HER DEB
THAT AWKWARD MOMENT WHEN YOU WALK TO THE WRONG CLASSROOM
WHEN SOMEONE COMMENTS ON A FIVE MONTH OLD POST
WHEN TWO COUNTRIES GO TO WAR FOR SOME REASON
THEIR PRESIDENTS SHOULD FIGHT 1 ON 1 TO DEATH INSTEAD OF SENDING YOUNG PEOPLE TO DIE

AS YOU ARRIVE AT YOUR DESTINATION
I PUT A TRUMP STICKER ON MY FRIENDS CAR AS A JOKE
SOMEONE THREW A BRICK THROUGH THE WINDOW
THAT FACE YOU MAKE WHEN
YOU THREATEN THE USA AND YOUR MISSILE BLOWS UP ON LAUNCH.

AND YOU INSTINCTLY SAY "YOU TOO"
WHEN SOMEONE SITS RIGHT NEXT TO YOU WHEN THERE'S A TON OF OTHER EMPTY CHAIRS
TEACHER: IS THERE A CHRISTIAN IN THIS CLASS? 20 KIDS RAISE THEIR HAND
WHEN YOU GO THROUGH A MASSIVE ARGUMENT ONLY TO REALISE YOU'RE WRONG
WHEN YOU MAKE A MEME WITH A GREAT JOKE BUT NOBODY GETS IT

meaning.meaning_en: This meme uses the seal's innocent yet slightly guilty expression to depict a situation where someone is caught in an embarrassing, awkward, or socially inappropriate moment. The first text box typically describes the innocent setup or action, while the second box reveals the sudden, cringeworthy consequence or the awkward realization that follows.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme nutzt den unschuldigen, aber leicht schuldbewussten Gesichtsausdruck des Robbens, um eine Situation darzustellen, in der jemand bei einer peinlichen, unangenehmen oder sozial unangemessenen Handlung erwischt wird. Das erste Textfeld beschreibt meist die harmlose Ausgangssituation, während das zweite das plötzliche, peinliche Ergebnis oder die unangenehme Erkenntnis offenbart.
situations_en: I just opened my laptop in the meeting and my screen share is still on
I accidentally replied to all on the company email with my rant
I waved at someone who wasn't waving at me
I just said 'you too' when the waiter said 'enjoy your meal'
I just laughed at a joke that was actually really mean
